fullTextEN: Hi, everyone,
I am Sasa.

fullTextZH: 上一次我告诉大家我有一个烦恼，
fullTextEN: Last time I told everyone I had a worry,
I want to change to a new phone,

fullTextZH: 但是我的眼睛有干眼症，
fullTextEN: but my eyes have dry eye syndrome,
and they easily hurt,
I need to buy a phone with an LCD screen.

fullTextZH: 这样的手机现在很难买到。
fullTextEN: Such phones are hard to find now.

fullTextZH: 如果你不知道什么是干眼症，
fullTextEN: If you don't know what dry eye syndrome is,
what an LCD screen is,

fullTextZH: 你可以去看我上一个视频。
fullTextEN: you can watch my previous video.

fullTextZH: 其实像我这样的人很多，
fullTextEN: Actually, there are many people like me,
our eyes have dry eye syndrome,

fullTextZH: 或者只是眼睛有一点敏感，
fullTextEN: or just have slightly sensitive eyes,

fullTextZH: 但是我们每天需要看手机很长时间。
fullTextEN: but we need to look at phones for a long time every day.

fullTextZH: 这样的人就会遇到一个问题：
fullTextEN: Such people will encounter a problem:

fullTextZH: 如果你想眼睛舒服一点，
fullTextEN: If you want your eyes to be more comfortable,
you can't use a good phone;
if you want to use a good phone,
then your eyes can't take it.
What should I do?
I checked online,
Friends online,

fullTextZH: 真的有很多有意思的方法。
fullTextEN: There are really many interesting methods.
For example, the first method:
Many people bought this iPad mini,
and use it as their phone.

fullTextZH: 因为iPad mini现在还在用LCD屏幕，
fullTextEN: Because the iPad mini still uses an LCD screen now,
and it's very new,
like the iPad mini 6 and 7,
they have many functions,
it's very fast to use,
no lag, and the performance is very good.

fullTextZH: 这样看起来也很像一个大手机。
fullTextEN: It also looks like a big phone.
But for me,
it's a bit too big,

fullTextZH: 我不能把它放进我的口袋里，
fullTextEN: I can't put it in my pocket,
it's very inconvenient,
my hands are not big enough,
it's not easy to hold.
The second method,
This method is very interesting.
There are some Chinese people,
They bought the latest iPhone,
For example, iPhone 16, 17,

fullTextZH: 然后他们马上把它拿到手机店里，
fullTextEN: Then they immediately take it to the phone store,
Ask the people in the phone store to help them,
To remove the original OLED screen,
And replace it with an LCD screen.
This LCD screen,

fullTextZH: 可能是中国的工厂生产的。
fullTextEN: Might be produced by a Chinese factory.

fullTextZH: 这样他们可以用到最好最新的手机，
fullTextEN: This way they can use the best and latest phone,

fullTextZH: 他们的眼睛也会舒服一点。
fullTextEN: And their eyes will be a bit more comfortable.

fullTextZH: 但是这个方法问题更大了。
fullTextEN: But this method has even bigger problems.
You bought a new phone,
You took it apart,
It cannot be under warranty;
If your phone breaks,
Apple will not care about you.

fullTextZH: 而且如果你遇到一个技术很差的人，
fullTextEN: Moreover, if you encounter someone with poor skills,

fullTextZH: 他把你的手机弄坏了怎么办？
fullTextEN: What if he broke your phone?
Even if it wasn't broken,
there might be other problems.
This method is not good.
The third method,
Some people are very direct,
they will buy two phones:

fullTextZH: 一个新款的手机很快很好用，
fullTextEN: A new model phone is fast and easy to use,
a cheap one,
a phone with an LCD screen.
In this way,

fullTextZH: 平时他们可以用这个新手机去工作去生活，
fullTextEN: they can use this new phone for work and life during normal times,

fullTextZH: 等他们觉得眼睛很累的时候，
fullTextEN: when they feel their eyes are very tired,
they switch to the phone with an LCD screen.
This method is too troublesome.
If I want to go out,
I have to take two phones out,
I think this method doesn't work.
Why can't these phone companies,

fullTextZH: 不能按照我们的要求生产手机呢？
fullTextEN: produce phones according to our requirements?
Maybe you feel,
this is just a problem for a few people,

fullTextZH: 但是和我一样的人真的不少，
fullTextEN: but there are really many people like me,
we are all very troubled,
our eyes really hurt,
but we can't live without our phones.

fullTextZH: 想要用一个新一点的好用的手机，
fullTextEN: want to use a newer, more useful phone,

fullTextZH: 这个不是少看一点手机，
fullTextEN: this is not a problem that can be solved by using the phone less,
it can be solved,
because our life, work,

fullTextZH: 付钱等等都离不开手机。
fullTextEN: paying money, etc., all can't be done without phones.
So there is a person,

fullTextZH: 他做了一件非常大胆的事情：
fullTextEN: he did something very bold:
he started writing to the EU.
Yes,
that's right,
it's the EU.
He told the EU:
phones with OLED screens,

fullTextZH: 可能会引起很多眼睛的问题，
fullTextEN: might cause many eye problems,

fullTextZH: 严重的甚至会引起眼睛的残疾。
fullTextEN: Severe cases can even cause eye disabilities.
So,

fullTextZH: 我们希望欧盟可以出一个新的政策，
fullTextEN: We hope the EU can introduce a new policy,

fullTextZH: 让所有生产手机的公司，
fullTextEN: to make all companies that produce phones,

fullTextZH: 都至少有一款手机是用LCD屏幕的，
fullTextEN: have at least one phone using an LCD screen,

fullTextZH: 这样我们就有选择的权利了。
fullTextEN: so we have the right to choose.

fullTextZH: 不管你喜欢什么品牌的手机，
fullTextEN: No matter what brand of phone you like,
you can choose an OLED screen,
or an LCD screen.

fullTextZH: 如果可以这样就太好了。
fullTextEN: It would be great if this could happen.

fullTextZH: 现在有很多人支持这个行动，
fullTextEN: Many people support this action now,

fullTextZH: 他们都开始给欧盟写信了。
fullTextEN: and they have started writing to the EU.
Because they feel that,

fullTextZH: 所有人都有被听见的权利。
fullTextEN: everyone has the right to be heard.
As for me,
I am still using an iPhone 11 now,

fullTextZH: 因为它是最后用LCD屏幕的苹果手机。
fullTextEN: because it is the last Apple phone with an LCD screen.

fullTextZH: 如果我真的很想换新手机，
fullTextEN: If I really want to change to a new phone,

fullTextZH: 可能我也会给欧盟写信吧。
fullTextEN: I might also write to the EU.
I am also waiting to see,

fullTextZH: 他们会不会出这样新的政策，
fullTextEN: Will they introduce such new policies?

fullTextZH: 帮助我们这些有干眼症的人。
fullTextEN: To help those of us with dry eye syndrome.

fullTextZH: 你呢？你现在用的是什么手机？
fullTextEN: What about you? What phone are you using now?
The time spent looking at the phone is very long,
Do you feel your eyes hurt a lot?

fullTextZH: 如果你也有这样的困扰，
fullTextEN: If you also have such troubles,
Will you write a letter to the EU?

fullTextEN: Feel free to tell us in the comments.
